Ym don u kynja ba don jingim, naduh u briew haduh u
mrad u mreng uba iaid ha sla khyndew, ki sim ki dob kiba her
ha suih, ki dohkha bad kiwei ki jaid jingim kiba don hapoh urn
bad wat ki dieng ki siej, ki syntiew ki skud, ki jingthung jingtep
ki ban ym ktah da ki sur jingtem jingput ne jingrwai. Ki puriskam
ki Greek ki ong ba haba u tern u Orpheus wat ki maw ruh ki
khih. Ki riewstad mynla pat ki pynshisha ba ki jingthung ki sei
ki plung bha haba ki iohsngew ia ki sur jingrwai.
Ki jingrwai, kliamtam kito kiba la shna bha, kata, kiba
iabiang ka dur bad ka sur ki ngam shaduh ka dohnud u briew
bad ki ktah ia ka jingsngew jong u. Haba nga ong ka dur bad ka
sur, nga mut ki ktien ka jingrwai bad ki sur ba la shna ban
pyniahap bad ki ktien ka jingrwai. Dei kane kajingpynbiang ia
ki ktien bad ki surkaba la pynim slem-slem iaki jingrwai kiba
rim bad shisien ba la iohsngew ia kine bad la nang ia ki, ki neh
sah ha ka jingkynmaw. Lym kumta i Bah L. Gilbert Shullai in
ym da la lah ban kynmaw ia ki jingrwai kiba i la iohsngew, nga

ngeit, naduh ba i dang khynnah. Wat u nongrwai ruh haba u
rwai ia ki jingrwai kiba rim u da pynpaw ba ki ktah ia ka dohnud
bad ka jingpyrkhat jong u, kata, kumba ong ha ka ktien Phareng,
u rwai da ka expression .
Baroh ki jingrwai ba la shna bha ia ki, ki don ia ka por ban
rwai ia ki. Don na ki kiba dei ban rwai mynstep, don pat kiba
dei ban rwai mynmiet. Don kiba dei ban rwai haba sngewsih
bad don pat kiba dei ban rwai haba sngewbha. Don kiba iadei
ban rwai haba sngewkynjah sngewblaw bad don kiba iadei ban
rwai haba paitbah. Ki don ki sur kiba ktah ia ka jingieit samla
bad ki don ki sur kiba pynsngewtriem ne pynshyrkhei.
Haba nga dang samla khynnah bad nga leit bud leit jingieit
ia u Sahep Bishar (Dohlieh) sha Mawphlang, katba nga dang
shongkai ha ka kamra ha iing u Lyngdoh Mawphlang ha kaba
la pynbeit ia nga ban sah, uwei u nong-Mawphlang u wan wad
ia nga hadien ba u la syaid bad shongshit bha bad u rwai artat ia
kawei ka jingrwai kaba ia rim bad kaba ju iarwai bha ha kita ki
por .
I m only painting the Clouds with Sunshine .
Ynda la iashongkai, nga sa sngewthuh ba u long u briew

uba shem lanot bha. Kumta ngi iohi hangne ba ka Jingrwai kaba
la shna bha bad dur bad sur ka ktah haduh katno ?
Kawei pat kaba pynshoh ia ka jingrwai ka long ka jingbuh
kaba biang ia ka rukom tied kaba ki ong ka Timing ne Measure,
la ka dei kaba shi-dieng shi-dieng, arsaw, laisaw kum ki Foxtrot,
ki Waltz, ki Rhumba, ki Samba, ki Bequine Tempo, ki March.
Ki don ki jingrwai kiba suki bad ki don ki jingrwai kiba stet. Ha
ki por hyndai haba dang shlei ka lewduh da ki doij i phin iohsngew
ia kine ki rukom rwai ha ka jingryntih ka jingiaid ki shalyntem
ka kor suhjaih ba la kynjat da ki kjat u nongrwai ne u dorj i, lane
ia ki Waltz haba kynoi khun ka kmie ne haba dril ki khynnah
bad kumta ter-ter.
Mynta ha kine ki por pat imat la shu shna ki jingrwai kiba
shisur tang ban shu pynsmiej ia ki kjat ki samla ne ki basan
kumjuh ban shad lymmuh. Tang shu iohsngew ia ki jingrwai, ia
shu tied klumar ia ka miej ka shuki bad ieng bad shad katba
(iu)
mon, kata ban Jive, Rock ne Disco. Ha ki samla jong ngi mynta
lei-lei imat la shu iashna klumar haduh ba ka dur kam iadei bad
ka sur ne ka sur kam iahap bad ka dur. Bun na ki jingrwai kiba

la shu pyniahap jubor ia ka dur bad tan jubor ia ka sur. Teng-
teng ia ka dur ruh ym sngewthuh bad ka sur ruh kam pei ia ka
shkor. Phin sngap ba don ki Cassette Khasi mynta kiba ka dur
ne ktien kaba mut shawei bad ka sur pat kaba thew shawei.
Kumba ong u paralok jong nga ba bun ki Cassette Khasi te
imat ki long Three in One - ka dur la ka jong, ka sur la ka jong
bad ka jingkynnoh ia ki ktien la ka jong. Te namar kata kim
biang keih.
Kawei pa kawei ka laih ba nyngkong jong ki jingrwai ha
kane KA MARYNTHING RUPA jong i Bah Gilbert ka
pynkynmaw ia nga ia ki por kiba ki jingrwai Phareng ki la long
don long snam ha u nongrwai nongtem Khasi bad la i kumba
kin long ka bynta jong ka Culture jong u Khasi hi. Kane ka lah
ban long, lehse, bym pat mih ki nongshna jingrwai Khasi kiba
tbit ban shna ki jingrwai kiba biang bad dur bad sur. Ki jingrwai
Khasi ba shna ha kito ki por ki long kito ki jingrwai ba la shna
dur ban pyniahap ha ki sur Dkhar bad ba rwai ne tern ia ki haba
ialehkai theater kum ha Jowai, Mawphlang, Mawngap, Marbisu,
Sohra, Mawsynram bad ha Seng Khasi ha Mawkhar.

Ka jingbang ia ki jingrwai Phareng ha ngi ki Khasi, imat ka
long hadien ka Thma Bah kaba nyngkong, kata hadien ka snem
1918 ynda ki Khasi jong ngi ki la iawan na France bad
Mesopotamia. Ynda la wan a ka Thma Bah kaba ar, la nang
jur shuh-shuh ka jingiarwai Phareng.
Haba nga kynmaw ia ki por shuwa ka Thma Bah kaba ar.
(iv)
ka wan shat ha nga ka dur jong ki radbah ha ka put ka tern, ka

Destar ba tem mandolin, Bah Kelly Diengdoh ba tbit bha ban
tem bela, accordian, Clarinet bad kiwei-kiwei ki jingtem jingput.
Bah Syndor ba put clarinet. Bah Jokes ba tem accordian. Bah
Bihsar ba tem Banjo, Bah Baden ba tem Ukeleie, Bah Reban
ba put besili. Nangta sa ki jong u Bah Theo Lyngdoh, Bah
Soverine. Bah Or eus Pakma, Bah Owen Rowie, Kong Trilian

tem Spanish Guitar, Bah Rayland Lyngdoh bad Kong Lenbuit

Nga dang kynmaw ba haba tem u Bah Kelly Diengdoh
shiteng miet ia kajingrwai Ramona ha surok Jaiaw, baroh ki
jingkhang - iit ki mih jingshai ban sngap ia ka sur kaba mih na

ka bela jong u bad kumjuh ruh haba put clarinet u Bah Syndor.
Nga la iohsngew ruh ia ki kti ba pnah jong u Bah Rishot
Khongwir ha ka bela bad u Bah Destar Khongwir ha ka mandolin
bad nga ia ioh ka lad ban iatem iang bad ki shisien arsien ia ki
jingrwai kiba nga dang kynmaw kum kajingrwai South of the
Border , Little Girl of my dream , After the Ball , Merry
Widow , Three Oclock in the Morning , Colonel Boogie
bad bun kiwei kiwci ki jingrwai. Ha kata ka por nga la pyntbit
iaiade ban tem mandolin bad bela.
Sngewtynnad ban kynmaw ia kitei ki radbah nongtem ba
kida pyntbit bha iaiade shuwa ba kin mih pyrthei bad kida nang
ruh ban pule Music, kata ia ka Staff. Ki long ki briew kiba
khraw kajingmut jingpyrkhat bad kirn ju pynthut ia kiwei. Ka
jingiatera ha kito ki por ka long ka jingsngewtynnad iaiade bad
ka jingpynsngewtynnad ia kiwei. Haba ki iatem ha surok, yrn ju
don ba pynwit, pynthuh ne kynroi ia ki. Don naki katba kira pat
sngewtynnad ne syaid bha, kim ju sdang ban iatem hynrei ki
ialeh ka pynbeit ksai. Uwei u rangbah u iathuh ba haba ki leit
iatem ha Shillong Club ha ki por ba dap ka Club da ki Dohlieh,

ynda u Chowkidar u lum ia ki bitor, u lap katto - katne ki bitor
khlem lavel ba la set da ka sla.
Ha ki snem kiba kham hadien la mih sa uwei u nongtem
bela uba tbit bha bad ufa u dei u Bah Besterwel Soanes. Ki ong
ba haba tern u Bah Besterwel ha ka Concert ha Gauhati Cotton
College, la hap cancel lut ia ki Item kiba hadien namar ki paitbah
ki ia kwah ia u Bah Besterwel ban tern baroh shimiet.
U nongtem bela uba la palat liam ia baroh ki nongtem Khasi
pat u dei u Bah Ramsong uba la khlad noh haba nga dang
khynnah bad ngam pat iohsngew ia ka jingtem Jong u, ne
kynmaw ia u. Ki ong ba haba tern u Bah Ramsong wat ki Mem
kiba la nang bha ban tern piano ki shitom ban iabud ia u haba ki
iatem na ka kot (Music Book), kata da ka Staff. U lah ban tern
ia ki sur Classical kiba eh katno-katno ruh namar u da nang bha
ia ka Staff Toi, la dei ban tei mot ia uba kat une u rangbah
nongtem ubaym pat ju don kat ma u ha ka Ri jong ngi bad ban
ym mih shuh ruh kiba kat ma u, khamtam mynta ba la shu tern

ne rwai tynnmg khlem da sngewthuh ne nang ia ka Music (nga
mut Staff Notation bad Tonic Solfa).
